_doc: Every gameplay/physics tuning value of the PoC. Units: design pixels (1080x1920), seconds, px/s, px/s^2. Water volumes are 2D areas in px^2.

tiers._doc: Size curve shared by every level: tier t covers base_area * ratio^(t-1) px^2 (1.45 => tier 9 ~19x tier 1). resistance[t-1] = seconds at full drain pressure to squeeze a plug of that tier through. PoC 3.1: tiers 7-9 survive a single emergency flush (the water still drains past them via leak_past_plug); only repeated flushes sacrifice them.

merge._triple_doc: TRIPLE MERGE: a pair waits triple_window s before merging; a third matching object that touches either (or rests within triple_pad px) joins and the three become TWO next-tier objects.
merge._scan_doc: Backup for the contact signal (it misses resting contacts in a crowded bowl): every scan_interval s matching pairs are shape-tested with touch_pad px of margin and merged.

chain._doc: Merges less than `window` s apart build a chain; multiplier = min(max_mult, 1 + step*(chain-1)) on merge points AND flush-meter gain (banked cascades).

meter._doc: Flush is an earned ability: merges fill the meter (per_merge + tier_bonus*(new_tier-2), x chain multiplier, + triple_bonus); a full meter = +1 flush charge. PoC 3: charges are the emergency flushes.

shake._doc: TOILET SHAKE bonus (game/fx/shake_hand.gd). Earned by merges: per_merge (+ triple_bonus) fills the shake meter, full = 1 shake (max max_charges). A cut-out hand reaches down (reach_time), grabs the rim (grab_pause) and shakes for `duration` s at `freq` Hz: on every beat (2 x freq per s, alternating left/right) every free object gets a velocity jolt (v = v * keep + jolt: never accumulates into a launch): kick_x sideways (x 1 +- jitter, plus a random share) and up to kick_y upward (they rub against each other -> new contacts -> merges), random spin; on each beat anything lower than throat_y - unplug_above (the funnel) is kicked up at unplug_speed (unclogs). The hand grips the right rim (inner rim x + grip_dx). Camera shake/tilt and water slosh are visual. anim_fps = stop-motion steps of the hand.

showcase._doc: PoC 4 presentation cards (game/ui/showcase.gd). INTRO: a tier with an `intro` line in levels.json, first discovery ever (saved): queued until the cascade is over (no pending merge, `chain.window` s since the last merge, not aiming, not flushing), pauses the game for `intro_time` real s (tap = dismiss). REVEAL: the level's last tier, every completion, when the royal flush arms: `drumroll` s silhouette, then the object; stays until ROYAL FLUSH. Then it shakes for royal.delay, breaks into pieces (`break_stagger` s apart) that spiral into the drain in `suck_time` s.

royal._doc: ROYAL FLUSH: creating the last tier of a level. Slow-mo for `delay` s, then a long vortex while every object is released into the drain one by one (`stagger` s, nearest first) and scored x multiplier. `timeout` s later stragglers are scored and removed and the level is complete.
royal._ready_doc: After the last tier is made: wait until no merge for `settle` s (the cascade finishes), then the FLUSH button becomes ROYAL FLUSH; overflow is off from the moment the last tier exists.

water._pressure_doc: Arcade pressure (PoC 3.1, owner: rising slower, partial clogs much slower). obstruction (0..1) above rise_from: water rises at lerp(rise_min, rise_max, x^rise_curve) px^2/s with x = (obstruction-rise_from)/(1-rise_from): partial clog ~3-5 min, severe ~1-1.5 min to overflow (empty bowl, capacity ~350k px^2). Below rise_from the water sinks at recover_rate; when a clog clears, clear_drop px^2 drain at once. Every object LOST to an emergency flush drains area*sacrifice_drain (max sacrifice_drain_max) extra: sacrifices buy time.

flush._vortex_doc: Side view of a whirlpool around the vertical drain axis: suction pulls DOWN (strongest on the axis), objects are drawn TOWARD the axis, the swirl shows as a sideways slosh + spin. All scaled by 1/(1 + distance_to_drain/falloff).
flush._doc: EMERGENCY FLUSH (costs a charge, scores nothing): strong vortex for `duration`, the drain removes outflow_rate*(1-blockage) px^2/s down to floor_below_rest px under the rest level; whatever reaches the outlet is lost. Plugs build squeeze pressure and can be pushed through (sacrificed). Water leaks past a plug: outflow = outflow_rate * (1 - blockage * (1 - leak_past_plug)), so even a plugged flush buys some time.

drain._obstruct_doc: obstruction = smoothed (obstruct_tau s) MEAN coverage of all drain lines from throat-obstruct_above down into the outlet (one object sitting in the throat = partial, a packed funnel = severe), or plug_seal when a wedged plug seals the funnel. Passing objects are filtered out by the smoothing. A plug counts as plug_seal * clamp(width / (drain_w * plug_full_width), plug_min_share, 1).
